meta: Video 69 only glanced at Claude in Chrome. This time it's a real run on Chrome, from installing it to Claude filling in a spreadsheet on its own, plus the safety rules to keep.

muc.title: This time for real
muc.text: In video 69 you only saw Claude in Chrome for a few seconds. This part does it for real in Chrome, from installation to Claude filling in a spreadsheet by itself.

muc.title: Install and connect your account
muc.text: Go to the Claude in Chrome page on the Chrome Web Store, click Add to Chrome, then click Authorize to connect your Claude account. Note that the extension needs a paid plan, Pro or higher, and only runs on desktop Chrome.

muc.title: A panel beside the page
muc.text: Click the Claude icon in the toolbar and a side panel opens on the right. Claude sees the page you have open, right next to the chat.

muc.title: Summarize and compare
muc.text: The first task is reading: open the Wikipedia article on artificial intelligence and a search page about machine learning, then ask Claude to summarize each in three points. It answers right in the side panel, with a comparison of how the two ideas differ in scope, method and type of problem.

muc.title: Claude clicks and types
muc.text: The second task is acting: ask Claude to open markhocai.com, get the titles of the five newest videos, and fill them into the open Google Sheets file, one video per row. After 17 actions, the five titles are neatly in the sheet.

muc.title: It even skips on its own
muc.text: Better still, two videos on the page weren't marked as released yet, so Claude treated them as not out and skipped them, then told you why.

muc.title: There's always a stop button
muc.text: While Claude works, Chrome shows a bar saying Claude is controlling the browser, with a Stop Claude button so you can stop it at any time.

muc.title: Two things you always do yourself
muc.text: Unfamiliar pages can hide instructions you can't see, so only use Claude on pages you trust. Logging in to your bank and clicking pay are things you always do yourself.

muc.title: Compare three items before buying
muc.text: Open three tabs for something you're planning to buy and ask Claude to build a table comparing price and warranty. Here it compares three air fryers, and points out that the pages don't show delivery fees yet, so you can ask before deciding.

muc.title: Next: Excel
muc.text: Part 2: Claude right inside Excel, analyzing a sales file of more than 7,000 rows without you having to remember a single formula.
